title: HelperSettings
description: helper.json (data folder root): the helper's model, "My night", whether it may wake the user at night, and "What the helper knows about you". Type HelperSettings in src/helper/settings.ts (with Night and FeedbackLine). Written by HelperSettingsStore.save (pretty JSON, 2-space indent, final newline, atomicWrite); read on every use by HelperSettingsStore.get, which starts from the defaults { model: "sonnet", night: { start: "22:00", end: "07:00" }, nightOptIn: null, feedback: [] }, so every key is written. Every unknown key is dropped on the next write (HelperSettingsStore.get); a port may do the same.

nightOptIn.description: May the helper wake the user at night for urgent things? null: not asked yet (treated as no).

feedback.description: Oldest first; the newest 100 are kept.

Night.description: Night: HH:MM to HH:MM in this Mac's time; may wrap past midnight. The API writes zero-padded times that differ; the reader also takes H:MM.

FeedbackLine.description: FeedbackLine: one line of "What the helper knows about you". The reader drops lines without string id and text.

id.description: f_ + now in base36 + 4 hex chars.
